headline: The exact saturated opposite-sign two-heavy centered-interval branch is globally below 3sqrt(2), uniformly over heavy-plane angle and output location.

theorem.name: QFORM-SATURATED-OPPOSITE-HEAVY-GLOBAL-v1
theorem.family: A_{m,theta}=R_m diag(1,1,-1) R_m^T with two saturated rows spanning the opposite-sign spectral plane and one m-row diffuse bank; exact nonzero spectrum {1,1,-1} for every m; all physical inputs Uniform[-1/2,1/2].

partner_applied.result: QFORM-FINITE-PERIOD-EDGEWORTH-OPT-v1: all-diffuse fully coupled three-bank orientations may approach the 3sqrt(2) obstruction with no fixed coupling-only gap; the present theorem gives the complementary fixed global gap at the saturated two-heavy endpoint.

correction_status: Live correction inbox reread after proof; no retraction required. The theorem uses no arbitrary-joint coarea bound, positive conditional-projection moments, scalar conditional-supremum gate, law-uniform pointwise decay, or post-rotation independence.
next_step: Search intermediate/mesoscopic leverage or fragmented nonuniform heavy laws; all-diffuse and saturated centered-interval two-heavy endpoints are now separated, while three-or-more heavy rows, non-Gaussian residual banks and extra spectral directions remain plausible escape mechanisms.
